repairs.evidenceText: DSIRE still lists the Ohio Energy Efficiency Program for Manufacturers as published with no end date and says applicants participate by contacting a participating audit contractor. Fairfield County's grant portal describes the Ohio Energy Efficiency Program as no formal application, ongoing until funds are expended, and the 2025 ODOD energy-grants workshop toolkit says the Energy Efficiency Program for Manufacturers/Non-manufacturers has funding available until it runs out.
repairs.notes: The official Ohio Development URL currently returns a 404 to direct browser/HTTP checks, so confidence stays below high. This is distinct from the FY26 Advanced Energy Fund Grant, which has a closed application window. The best supported classification for DSIRE 5587 is rolling because the program path uses participating audit contractors/no formal application and secondary grant references say funding is available until exhausted.
